commit.subject: LU-20592 llite: request dir layout in search_inode_for_lustre
commit.message:
LU-20592 llite: request dir layout in search_inode_for_lustre

After loading a Lustre inode through NFS by a filehandle,
the striping info for directories might not be loaded
because fetching of corresponding EA is not requested.

Signed-off-by: Alexander Zarochentsev <alexander.zarochentsev@hpe.com>
Change-Id: Ifd21fcd5c9cc3efef3c2dd38df83c53606926bf9
